nodes.title: Recommended Default Rules For Future Projects
Anti-Patterns To Avoid When Reusing This Architecture
UI Quality And State Design Practices

nodes.name: domain
nodes.description: Pure business layer containing models, use cases, repository interfaces, and domain errors.

nodes.name: data
nodes.description: Runtime integration layer containing repository implementations, DTOs, local and remote sources, and boundary mapping.

nodes.name: presentation
nodes.description: UI-facing layer containing screens, view models, UI models, and presentation mappers.

nodes.name: shared_core
nodes.description: Shared cross-cutting infrastructure split by responsibility.

nodes.name: navigation
nodes.description: App-shell routing and navigation ownership layer.

nodes.name: design_system
nodes.description: Shared tokens, components, and string resources.

nodes.name: Package by feature
nodes.statement: Package product behavior by feature rather than by technical layer alone.

nodes.name: Split shared core by responsibility
nodes.statement: Split shared core infrastructure by responsibility and dependency weight instead of using one giant core module.

nodes.name: Use typed result wrappers
nodes.statement: Use typed result wrappers for domain-facing operations and feature-specific error hierarchies for expected failures.

nodes.name: Use cancellation-safe suspend result helpers
nodes.statement: Wrap suspend infrastructure work with one shared helper that rethrows CancellationException and maps only real failures into domain or app errors.

nodes.name: Prefer cache-first reads
nodes.statement: Prefer local cache as the first read path in offline-first or low-churn features when appropriate.

nodes.name: Keep MVI infrastructure small
nodes.statement: Keep the base MVI view model small and practical, providing only primitives the team actually uses.

nodes.name: Decouple feature UI from routing
nodes.statement: Keep route-to-screen wiring in the shared composition root and keep feature modules free of global route dependencies unless they own a nested graph.

nodes.name: Centralize user-visible strings
nodes.statement: Keep shared user-visible strings in shared/core-strings Compose Resources and export the generated Res class publicly for cross-module consumers.

nodes.name: Prefer constructor injection
nodes.statement: Use constructor injection for repositories, use cases, and view models whenever possible.

nodes.name: Reuse shared test utilities
nodes.statement: Keep fake providers and coroutine-aware helpers in shared/core-testing and reuse them from feature tests.

nodes.name: Share business logic without forcing shared UI
nodes.statement: Share domain and data logic broadly, but do not force shared UI when native UI is the better product choice.

nodes.name: Keep iOS hosts structurally obvious
nodes.statement: Native SwiftUI hosts should organize code under Core, Models, ViewModels, and Views, and iOS has no Compose host (Compose is Android-only).

nodes.name: Use a dedicated Swift bridge boundary
nodes.statement: Expose shared Kotlin capabilities to the native host through one dedicated bridge and keep Kotlin-to-Swift mapping inside that boundary.

nodes.name: Use shared Xcode schemes in packaged templates
nodes.statement: Commit shared Xcode schemes under xcshareddata and do not depend on user-specific xcuserdata schemes in packaged templates.

nodes.name: Swift-visible shared types require export plus api
nodes.statement: If Swift should see types from dependent shared modules, the framework must export those modules and the dependency chain must use api instead of implementation.

nodes.name: Keep iOS framework search paths deterministic
nodes.statement: FRAMEWORK_SEARCH_PATHS should point at shared/build/xcode-frameworks/$(CONFIGURATION)/$(SDK_NAME) without duplicate or corrupted entries.

nodes.name: Swift unit tests run in a hosted appTests target
nodes.statement: The Xcode project has an app target (the only one with the Kotlin Toolchain integration script phase) and a hosted appTests unit-test target; Swift tests live in iosApp/test, use @testable import app, and run with xcodebuild test -scheme app; ./kotlin test runs only Kotlin tests.

nodes.name: Guessing ObjC-shaped Swift API names
nodes.statement: Do not guess underscore-suffixed enum cases, constructor labels, or other ObjC-shaped names in Swift because there is no SKIE: Kotlin enums and sealed classes are Swift classes, so switch needs a default branch.
nodes.replacementGuidance: Verify the generated Objective-C API after shared changes and update Swift code to use the real class names, async signatures, and initializer labels.

nodes.name: Canonical dependency direction
nodes.statement: Enforce Presentation -> Domain <- Data dependency direction.

nodes.name: Domain stays pure Kotlin
nodes.statement: Domain must remain platform-agnostic and framework-light.

nodes.name: Time flows through TimeProvider
nodes.statement: Domain and feature code must not call Clock.System.now() directly and should access time through TimeProvider.

nodes.name: Repositories own boundary translation
nodes.statement: Repositories map DTOs and entities into domain models, convert infrastructure failures into domain errors, and expose domain-friendly return types.

nodes.name: Never swallow coroutine cancellation
nodes.statement: Repository helpers must always rethrow CancellationException.

nodes.name: Prefer named per-feature HttpClient
nodes.statement: Each data module that talks to a backend should own its own named HttpClient unless there is a strong reason to share one.

nodes.name: Keep mappers at their boundaries
nodes.statement: Keep DTO, entity, and domain mapping in data; keep domain-to-UI mapping in presentation.

nodes.name: Separate state, actions, and events
nodes.statement: Presentation should distinguish long-lived state, input actions, and one-off events.

nodes.name: Use lifecycle-backed ViewModels for long-lived screen state
nodes.statement: In multiplatform Compose apps, long-lived screen state should use lifecycle ViewModel rather than a plain class so Android preserves it across configuration changes.

nodes.name: Process rapid UI actions sequentially
nodes.statement: If actions can arrive rapidly, the base presentation layer should queue them through one sequential processor instead of launching one coroutine per action.

nodes.name: Use one consistent presentation pattern
nodes.statement: Prefer one consistent presentation pattern across the app, using the shared MVI base unless there is a compelling reason not to.

nodes.name: App shell owns global navigation and theme
nodes.statement: The root app shell should own app-wide navigation, theme application, and safe-area handling.

nodes.name: Use typed routes
nodes.statement: Model Navigation 3 routes as typed values in one canonical shared route hierarchy instead of raw strings or duplicated route types.

nodes.name: No hardcoded user-visible strings in shared UI
nodes.statement: All user-visible strings in shared UI should come from shared/core-strings resources or another deliberate shared resource module.

nodes.name: Start DI only at the top level
nodes.statement: Call startKoin only from top-level app initialization paths and do not let features bootstrap DI themselves.

nodes.name: Register lifecycle ViewModels through DI
nodes.statement: Lifecycle ViewModels should be registered through the DI container's view-model DSL in UI modules and retrieved from Compose instead of being built from rememberCoroutineScope().

nodes.name: Abstract platform capabilities behind shared contracts
nodes.statement: Define platform capability contracts in shared code, provide platform implementations separately, and inject them through DI.

nodes.name: Aggregator feature exception
nodes.statement: An aggregator-style feature may depend on other features' domain modules only, never their presentation modules.

nodes.name: Cross-feature data-module coupling
nodes.statement: Do not let feature data modules depend casually on other feature data modules.
nodes.replacementGuidance: Move shared logic into shared core, expose a domain contract, or isolate setup behavior behind a dedicated shared service.

nodes.name: Raw preference parsing outside repositories
nodes.statement: Do not mix raw preference parsing into UI or domain layers.
nodes.replacementGuidance: Convert primitive storage values into domain types at the repository boundary.

nodes.name: Direct system time access
nodes.statement: Do not call system time directly throughout the app.
nodes.replacementGuidance: Use a dedicated production time provider as the only clock access point.

nodes.name: Navigation route leakage into features
nodes.statement: Do not let navigation route types leak into every feature module by default.
nodes.replacementGuidance: Keep route-to-screen wiring in the shared composition root and pass intent-level callbacks when feature UI does not own routing.

nodes.name: Hardcoded shared UI strings
nodes.statement: Do not hardcode user-visible strings in shared UI code.
nodes.replacementGuidance: Use shared/core-strings Compose Resources or another deliberate shared resource module as the source of truth for user-visible strings.

nodes.name: Giant build templates
nodes.statement: Do not create giant module templates that hide the whole build.
nodes.replacementGuidance: Keep templates narrow and keep real module dependencies explicit in each module.yaml.

nodes.name: Overbuilt MVI framework
nodes.statement: Do not build a complicated MVI framework if a small base class is enough.
nodes.replacementGuidance: Keep the MVI base minimal and focused on reusable primitives.

nodes.name: No cross-feature presentation coupling
nodes.statement: Feature presentation modules should not depend on other feature presentation modules.

nodes.name: Derive one canonical app identity
nodes.statement: Derive one canonical app identity first and normalize package roots, namespaces, app ids, and visible app identity from that source of truth.

nodes.name: Assemble dependencies at stable composition roots
nodes.statement: Repositories, use cases, and ViewModels should be created at stable roots or factories, not inside recomposing composable bodies.

nodes.name: Root composables retrieve stable ViewModels instead of building them
nodes.statement: Root composables may retrieve DI-managed ViewModels, but they should not manufacture them by creating repositories or coroutine scopes in the composition path.

nodes.name: Define intentional state UX
nodes.statement: Loading, empty, content, and error states should have explicit contract expectations and should not remain placeholder-level at review time.

nodes.name: Dependency assembly inside recomposing composables
nodes.statement: Do not instantiate repositories, use cases, or ViewModels inside recomposing composables.
nodes.replacementGuidance: Move assembly to app initialization, a stable factory, or another orchestration-focused root and pass constructed dependencies downward.

nodes.name: Keep xcstrings keys and values in sync with shared strings.xml
nodes.statement: Every xcstrings key must match a strings.xml name, and every English value must match the XML value, with %1$s converted to %@. iOS-only strings use an ios_ infix.
